verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਚੂਨੋ ਖਾਂਡ ਸ੍ਵੇਤ ਏਕ ਸੇ ਦਿਖਾਈ ਦੇਤ  ਪਾਈਐ ਤਉ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਰਸ ਰਸਨਾ ਕੈ ਚਾਖੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise choono khaa(n)dd savaiet ek se dhikhaiee dhet  paieeaai tau savaiaadh ras rasanaa kai chaakheeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as both sugar and flour being white look alike, but can only be identified when tasted (one is sweet, the other insipid).

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪੀਤ ਬਰਨ ਹੀ ਹੇਮ ਅਰੁ ਪੀਤਰ ਹੁਇ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਮਹਤ ਪਾਰਖਦ ਅਗ੍ਰ ਰਾਖੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise peet baran hee hem ar peetar hui jaaneeaai mahat paarakhadh agr raakheeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as brass and gold bear the same colour, but when both are placed before an examiner, the value .of gold is known.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਊਆ ਕੋਕਿਲਾ ਹੈ ਦੋਨੋ ਖਗ ਸਿਆਮ ਤਨ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਅਸੁਭ ਸੁਭ ਸਬਦ ਸੁ ਭਾਖੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise kuooaa kokilaa hai dhono khag siaam tan boojheeaai asubh subh sabadh su bhaakheeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as both a crow and a cuckoo is black in colour, but they can be distinguished by their voice. (One is sweet to the ears while the other is noisy and irritating).

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਚਿਹਨ ਕੈ ਸਮਾਨ ਹੋਤ  ਕਰਨੀ ਕਰਤੂਤ ਲਗ ਲਛਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਖੀਐ ॥੫੯੬॥
verses.translit_en: taise hee asaadh saadh chihan kai samaan hot  karanee karatoot lag lachhan kai laakheeaai ||596||

en.bdb: Similarly, outer signs of a real and a fake saint look alike but their actions and characteristics can reveal who is genuine among them. (Only then can one know who is good and who is bad).  (596)
